title: st.App does not discover script-level .streamlit/config.toml
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

When using `st.App` with an external ASGI server and the working directory differs from the script directory,
script-level `.streamlit/config.toml` is silently ignored. The same config works with `streamlit run`.

I think there is a 1-line fix.

### Reproducible Code Example

Given a directory structure:

```
myproject/
├── myapp/
│   ├── .streamlit/
│   │   └── config.toml
│   ├── app.py
│   └── asgi.py
```

myapp/.streamlit/config.toml :
```
[theme]
primaryColor = "#ff0000"
```

myapp/app.py :
```
import streamlit as st
st.title("Config Discovery Test")
st.write(f"primaryColor = {st.get_option('theme.primaryColor')}")
```

myapp/asgi.py :
```
from streamlit.starlette import App
app = App("app.py")
```

### Steps To Reproduce

```bash
cd myproject
uvicorn myapp.asgi:app --port 8501
```

### Expected Behavior

`primaryColor` should be `#ff0000`, indicating that the config TOML was picked up.

This matches the behaviour of `streamlit run myapp/app.py`.

### Current Behavior

`primaryColor` is `None` (default). The script-level config.toml is silently ignored.

Note: if you `cd myapp` first, it works, because CWD-based discovery happens to find it, not because `st.App` wired it up.

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.57
- Python version: 3.11
- Operating System: Linux
- Browser: Chrome

### Additional Information

Suspected root cause: 

Config file discovery (`config.get_config_files`) only searches the script's directory if `config._main_script_path` is set. 

`streamlit run` sets this (`cli.py:296`), but `App.__init__` and its lifespan startup do not, despite already resolving the script path via `_resolve_script_path()`.

Proposed fixL in `App._combined_lifespan`, before calling `prepare_streamlit_environment`, add:

```python
config._main_script_path = str(script_path)
```
A workaround is to set the `_main_script_path` attribute manually, but this feels flaky as it's a private attribute:

```python
from streamlit import config
from streamlit.starlette import App

config._main_script_path = str(Path(__file__).parent / "app.py")
app = App("app.py")
```

### Triage Analysis

This is a valid bug report against the new `st.App` / Starlette ASGI entry point. When an app is launched via an external ASGI server (e.g. `uvicorn myapp.asgi:app`) from a working directory that is *not* the script's directory, the script-level `.streamlit/config.toml` is silently ignored. The same config is loaded correctly under `streamlit run`.

The submitter's root-cause analysis is correct and verified against the code:

- `config.get_config_files()` only appends the script-level config when the module-level `config._main_script_path` is set ([`lib/streamlit/config.py:2728`](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/blob/develop/lib/streamlit/config.py#L2728)).
- `streamlit run` sets it before loading config options ([`lib/streamlit/web/cli.py:296`](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/blob/develop/lib/streamlit/web/cli.py#L296): `_config._main_script_path = main_script_path`).
- `App._combined_lifespan` ([`lib/streamlit/web/server/starlette/starlette_app.py:541`](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/blob/develop/lib/streamlit/web/server/starlette/starlette_app.py#L541)) already resolves the script path via `_resolve_script_path()` and calls `prepare_streamlit_environment(...)`, but never assigns `config._main_script_path`, so the script-level config search is skipped.

The "it works after `cd myapp`" observation is consistent: in that case the project-level lookup (cwd-based) coincidentally finds the same file. The suggested one-line fix (setting `config._main_script_path = str(script_path)` before `prepare_streamlit_environment`) looks reasonable; the same fix likely needs to be mirrored in the AppTest/non-lifespan path (`starlette_app.py` ~L700-724) for consistency, and unit tests should cover both the relative-path and cwd-differs-from-script-dir scenarios.

### Related Issues

- [#13600 — \[Request for feedback\] Starlette/ASGI Support in Streamlit](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/13600): Umbrella/feedback issue for the new `st.App` ASGI surface that this bug lives under.
- [#7731 — Allow different paths for storing configuration files](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/7731): Related concern about where Streamlit looks for `config.toml`/`secrets.toml`; not a duplicate but adjacent to script-level config discovery.
- [#7578 — Add `--config-file` arg to `streamlit run` for manual specification of config.toml location](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/7578): Same area (control over config discovery location), relevant if the team considers exposing an explicit config-path option on `App(...)` alongside fixing the auto-discovery bug.
